question: A penalty is struck at 100 km/h from 11 m. How many seconds does the ball take to reach the goal line?
move: When reacting takes longer than the event, decide before it starts.
hint: Turn km/h into metres per second by dividing by 3.6.
source: IFAB, Laws of the Game, Law 14
reference: The International Football Association Board, Laws of the Game 2024/25, Law 14: The Penalty Kick, 2024
